about: Probe of tools/int8_guard.py: prompts written for this test (none from a dataset), fp32 scores of the small variant computed by `int8_guard.py reference` with tantive's OnnxModel.

reference.source: students/v7_small_vocab32k/model of the research repo (the source of scombat/s1d1-router-6src-small-onnx-int8), exported to fp32 ONNX by its pipeline/07_variants.py make-onnx without --int8
